summary: Specifies the RiskEngine that performs real-time counterparty exposure monitoring, credit limit enforcement, and risk breach notifications. The engine calculates weighted exposure across T+0 to T+2 settlement windows, triggers margin calls at 80% of limits, enforces 25% concentration caps, suspends counterparties after 10 consecutive check failures, and integrates with notification auditing.
